advice: Abstain. No distinct legal B-panel experiment is established by the supplied evidence. The prior proposal only changed the full512 helper's B pointer, and its layout compatibility remained unverified. A safe experiment needs a specified consumer that accepts the packed layout, with coordinated packing and stride changes; the evidence provides none. The sixteen panel32 calls have already been tested, so repeating them is not distinct.
risks: Changing only parameters[4] may violate the full512 kernel's expected B layout and produce incorrect output. Any future packed-B path must preserve all FP32 values, keep allocation and packing inside gemm and timed, and retain the existing ABI, general-size fallback, and n<=0 behavior. Check full n=512 correctness, general sizes and tails, and fresh paired measurements under unchanged settings. Prior joint measurements do not establish a B-packing effect.
